description: Merged bank reconciliation entry point. Use mode='suggest' for invoice-match suggestions, mode='dry_run_auto_confirm' or mode='execute_auto_confirm' for exact invoice matches (confidence >= 90, or the ref_number_exact rule: the reference of exactly one open unpaid EUR invoice + the exact EUR amount + a proven direction matching the invoice kind, or the document_reference_exact rule: payment text naming exactly one open unpaid EUR purchase invoice by its number or order number + the exact amount + a verified outgoing CAMT direction; such rows keep their lower confidence and carry auto_confirm_rule), mode='inter_account_dry_run' for own-account transfer detection, and mode='execute_inter_account' (REQUIRES the plan_handle from the dry run) to reconcile the reviewed inter-account transfers.

block_on_duplicate.description: For the invoice-matching modes (suggest / dry_run_auto_confirm / execute_auto_confirm): refuse (or, in suggest, flag) an exact match whose cash movement appears already booked by another journal. Default false = advisory only.

delete_proposed_mirrors.description: Inter-account only, opt-in: bind each proposed mirror deletion (a PROJECT row already journalized from the other account side) into the dry-run plan; execute deletes only rows still matching the reviewed identity. Resend the same value at execute.

keep_side.description: Inter-account only: which leg of a matched transfer pair is confirmed (the other is deleted). Default outgoing. incoming requires a checksum-verified incoming CAMT marker on that leg, else the pair goes to ambiguous_pairs (direction_unresolved). Resend the same value at execute.

max_date_gap.description: Maximum days between inter-account transfer legs (default 1, max 31).

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for invoice matching modes (auto-confirm default 90). Above 90 also disables ref_number_exact and document_reference_exact.

mode.description: Workflow phase to run. Defaults to suggest.

plan_handle.description: Execution-plan handle from the reviewed dry run. Required for mode='execute_auto_confirm' and mode='execute_inter_account', and forwarded to the executor.

target_accounts_dimensions_id.description: For inter_account_dry_run one-sided transfers, specify the target bank account dimension ID when it cannot be inferred.

name: reconcile_bank_transactions
title: Reconcile Bank Transactions
